## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text is [淨源](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B7%A8%E6%BA%90) Jìngyuán's sub-commentary and supplementary explication on [法藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%97%8F) Fǎzàng's *[Wàng jìn huán yuán guān](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0090)* (T1876) and on the (now-lost) earlier Tang sub-commentary on it. The *bǔjiě* 補解 "supplementary explication" format indicates that Jìngyuán is filling in gaps in the earlier commentarial tradition rather than providing a wholly new commentary.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (1067 – 1088) reflects the period of [淨源](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B7%A8%E6%BA%90) Jìngyuán's mature editorial activity. Together with his *[Huán yuán guān kē](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0091)* (X993), the *Bǔjiě* completes Jìngyuán's editorial-commentarial work on Fǎzàng's contemplative text — re-establishing the *Huán yuán guān* as a foundational text in the Sòng Huáyán curriculum. The work was widely studied in subsequent Sòng-Yuán-Míng Buddhist contemplative practice and was carried to Korea and Japan as part of the standard *Huán yuán guān* study apparatus.

The work is preserved in the Manji *Xù zàng jīng* (X994) collection.
